description: Opaque cream floor-length court dress with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and sleeves ending around the elbows. Narrow gold geometric embroidered borders outline the neckline, sleeve ends, vertical front strips and hem. A broad gold-brown woven sash is secured with a round gold clasp and has tassel-ended ties. A brown-gold patterned wrap rests along the forearms and hangs at either side with wide ornamented borders. A front walking opening is below the knee and reveals a lower leg and gold-brown closed shoe. Dangling gold earrings and a small ring are visible. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
